GET /health: Is the server healthy? Checks the database and background jobs; 200 when healthy, 503 when not.
POST /api/partner/moormove/events: Delivery updates from MoorMove, the partner rider service (picked up, delivered, failed). Only MoorMove can call it.
GET /sitemap.xml: Live products, shops, municipalities, categories, static pages; 404 on a non-indexable deployment, 503 if the build fails.
GET /api/health: Liveness without a DB ping: { message:'E-MOORM API is running', timestamp, environment }.
GET /api: This page, or the API name and version as JSON.
POST /api/auth/login: Email + password sign-in; tokens, or an MFA step-up.
POST /api/auth/google: "Continue with Google" from the website popup (auth code / ID token); signs in, or asks to complete sign-up for a new person.
POST /api/auth/google/complete: Finish a Google sign-up (details the new account still needs).
GET /api/auth/google/app/start: Android app: redirects the phone's browser to Google's consent.
GET /api/auth/google/app/callback: Google's redirect target for the app flow; hands a one-time ticket back to the app.
POST /api/auth/google/app/exchange: The app trades the one-time ticket for a session.
POST /api/auth/google/app/ticket: The same ticket from the website's own Google popup (/app-google).
POST /api/auth/refresh-token: Rotate the refresh session; new { accessToken, refreshToken }.
POST /api/auth/forgot-password: Email a reset link (same answer whether or not the address exists).
POST /api/auth/reset-password: Set a new password with the emailed token (1 hour, stored hashed).
POST /api/auth/verify-email: Confirm the email address from the welcome email's link.
POST /api/auth/resend-verification: Send a fresh confirmation link to the signed-in account.
POST /api/auth/logout: Revoke this device's refresh session (body refreshToken).
POST /api/auth/logout-all: Sign out everywhere: revoke every session of the account.
PUT /api/auth/profile: Update name, handle, contact, address, photo (address also becomes the default delivery address when complete).
POST /api/auth/change-password: Change password (current one required); other sessions end.
POST /api/auth/apply-seller: Submit the seller application (KYC file ids, shop details, terms version); notifies the town's municipal admins.
GET /api/auth/seller-application: The caller's seller application and its status.
PUT /api/auth/seller-application/draft: Save the application form as a draft.
PATCH /api/auth/seller-application/detai: Add business and payout details after applying (guided setup).
GET /api/auth/users: Paginated user list (municipal admins: own municipality; contact details masked).
POST /api/auth/users/:id/reveal: Show a user's real contact details for a stated reason (audit logged).
GET /api/auth/users/:id/kyc-photo/:field: Stream a private KYC image (ID front/back, selfie, permit); access checked in the service.
POST /api/auth/users/:id/approve-seller: Approve a seller application (role becomes SELLER).
POST /api/auth/users/:id/reject-seller: Reject a seller application with a reason.
POST /api/auth/users/:id/purge: Permanently delete the account and what it owns; body { confirm: 'DELETE' }.
POST /api/auth/users/:id/set-role: Change a user's role (for example make a municipal admin).
GET /api/auth/phone/config: Whether phone verification by SMS is turned on.
POST /api/auth/phone/send: Text a 6-digit code to { number } (10-minute code, daily caps).
POST /api/auth/phone/verify: Check { code }; marks the number verified.
POST /api/auth/mfa/verify-login: Finish a sign-in with a TOTP or backup code; issues tokens.
POST /api/auth/mfa/setup/begin-login: Admin's forced enrolment during sign-in: new secret + QR.
POST /api/auth/mfa/setup/complete-login: Confirm the first code, turn MFA on, get backup codes and tokens.
GET /api/auth/mfa/status: Whether MFA is on and how many backup codes remain.
POST /api/auth/mfa/setup/begin: Start enrolment from Settings (re-enrolment needs a current code).
POST /api/auth/mfa/setup/complete: Confirm the code and enable MFA.
POST /api/auth/mfa/disable: Turn MFA off. Refused (403) for admin roles: "MFA is required for admin accounts and cannot be disabled".
POST /api/auth/qr/create: Website: start a QR sign-in; returns QR image (data URL), token, expiry.
GET /api/auth/qr/status/:token: Website polls; after approval it collects the session once.
POST /api/auth/qr/scan: Signed-in phone scanned the code (shows who is asking).
POST /api/auth/qr/approve: Phone approves (or declines) the browser's sign-in.
GET /api/account/deletion: Can this account be closed now, and what still blocks it.
POST /api/account/delete: Close the account (password confirmed); erased after 30 days.
GET /api/account/export: Download a copy of everything held about the person.
POST /api/account/users/:id/restore: Undo an owner's closing within the 30 days.
GET /api/me/cart: The saved cart lines (product, options, quantity) with display data.

GET /api/questions/product/:productId.text: A product's answered questions (asker's first name only).

POST /api/questions/product/:productId: Ask the shop a question (201 "Question sent to the shop").
POST /api/views/product/:id: Product page view; counted once per visitor per 30 min; 202 { success, counted }.
POST /api/app/ping: The site inside the Android app reports { installId, launch }; 202 { success, recorded }.
GET /api/app/downloads: Rounded APK download count for the /app page ("100+").
GET /api/app/stats: Downloads, installs per version, who uses the app.
GET /api/profiles/:id: A person's minimal public profile (or which shop is theirs).
PUT /api/municipalities/:id: Edit a municipality (a municipal admin only their own).
POST /api/municipalities/seed: Insert the default Oriental Mindoro municipalities.
GET /api/stores/slug/:slug/storefront: Public shop page data plus the caller's follow status.
GET /api/stores/slug/:slug/home: The shop's Home tab sections with current product prices.
GET /api/stores/map: Every public shop with a map position (pinned or approximate).
GET /api/stores/my/attention: Seller Center badges: what is waiting on the seller.
GET /api/stores/my/health: Shop health (level, issues, live products, rating, followers).
GET /api/stores/my/announcements: Announcements the seller sent to followers.
POST /api/stores/my/announcements: Send a shop update / product to followers (daily limit).
PUT /api/stores/my/guides: Mark an in-app guide { key } as done.
PUT /api/stores/my/home: Save the Home tab sections (banner, spotlight, gallery).
PUT /api/stores/my/service-areas: Replace the service areas with { areas }.
GET /api/stores/my/delivery: Own delivery in one piece: areas, fee mode, fees.
PUT /api/stores/my/delivery: , areas, perKm? } in one transaction (400 with field errors).

GET /api/stores/:id/coverage.text: Does the store deliver to this place, and for how much.

PUT /api/stores/:id: Edit the store (look, hours, payment QR, pickup, settings).
POST /api/stores/:id/suspend: Suspend a store with { reason } (audit logged).
GET /api/follows/status/:storeId: Whether the caller follows the store; follower count.
PATCH /api/follows/:storeId/notification: Turn the store's notifications on/off for the follower.
GET /api/follows/store/:storeId/stats: Follower statistics for the store owner.
GET /api/products/slug/:slug: Product detail by slug (the product page).
POST /api/products/search-by-image: Find similar products by photo (perceptual hash); nothing stored.
GET /api/products/my/summary: Counts of the seller's products by state.
POST /api/products: Create a product (goes to admin approval).

GET /api/products.text: The public catalogue (municipal admins scoped to their town; a seller's own products left out of their view).

PUT /api/products/:id/model3d: Set the product's 3D view (shape template + uploaded GLB/USDZ).
POST /api/products/:id/stock: Restock or correct stock (a restock from zero tells followers).

GET /api/today.text: What buyers can order right now.

GET /api/today/mine.text: The seller's windows (current, or past ones).

GET /api/today/menu: The shop's Available Today menu: { enabled, items, choices }.
POST /api/today/menu: Add { productId } to the menu (0 in stock until posted).
DELETE /api/today/menu/:productId: Take an item off the menu (refused while a post is live/upcoming).
POST /api/today: Publish one window for an Available Today product (201).
PATCH /api/today/:id: Change a window (once ordered: product, kind, day, opening time stay).
POST /api/today/:id/quantity: Add to or take from the batch: { delta }.
POST /api/today/:id/repeat: Publish again on { date } or { dates[] } (201).

GET /api/offers/estimate.text: Typical price per head for this animal in the shop's town.

POST /api/offers: Start a deal: price per head for some heads (201).
GET /api/offers/mine: The caller's deals as a buyer.
POST /api/offers/:id/:action: A step: action = price | accept | decline | meetup | call-off | record | confirm | not-right (whose turn it is is checked).
POST /api/orders: Checkout: one order per shop; payment COD | GCASH | QRPH, fulfillment DELIVERY | PICKUP; stock reserved, seller notified (201).

GET /api/orders/my/orders.text: Manila), search (<= 40 chars), paymentStatus The buyer's orders (paginated).

POST /api/orders/:id/cancel: Cancel an order (buyer, or the shop as seller, when allowed).
POST /api/orders/:id/received: Buyer confirms receipt -> COMPLETED (COD becomes PAID).
GET /api/orders/:id/buyer-record: The buyer's history with this shop (for deciding an order).
PATCH /api/orders/:id/ship: Hand to a courier: { courierId, trackingNumber }.
PATCH /api/orders/:id/payment: Seller decides the payment: { paymentStatus PAID | FAILED | REFUNDED, note? }.

GET /api/orders.text: All orders (municipal admins forced to own town; contact details masked).

GET /api/orders/:id: One order with items, history, deadlines, rider delivery.
GET /api/orders/store/rider-cash: Cash-on-delivery money riders hold or returned for the shop.
GET /api/orders/unpaid-fees: Failed-trip delivery fees the buyer owes (shown at checkout).
POST /api/orders/:id/unpaid-fee/waive: Waive a buyer's unpaid failed-trip fee.
GET /api/orders/:id/tracking: Live rider position, shop and buyer pins, final flag.
POST /api/orders/:id/rider: "Call a rider": book a MoorMove job for a packed order.
POST /api/orders/:id/rider/self: Switch the order to the shop's own delivery.
POST /api/orders/:id/rider/cash-received: Seller confirms the rider handed over the COD cash.
POST /api/orders/:id/rider/parcel-return: Seller confirms a failed delivery's parcel is back.
GET /api/moormove/status: Whether the MoorMove option is on (super admin switch + configured + open) and its towns.
POST /api/moormove/quote: Rider fee for the checkout's shop and delivery pin.
GET /api/moormove/admin/health: Connection check against the MoorMove API.
GET /api/reviews/my/pending: Items received but not yet reviewed.
POST /api/reviews: Review a received product { productId, rating, comment } with media; bytes verified.
DELETE /api/reviews/:id: Delete a review (author, or an admin - checked in the service).
POST /api/returns: Request a return/refund for an order item (within its window).
POST /api/returns/:id/dispute: Buyer disputes the shop's rejection (to the admins).
POST /api/returns/:id/resolve-dispute: Admin decides a dispute { decision: BUYER | SELLER, note (>= 5) }.
POST /api/reports: Report a product, seller/store or buyer { type, reason, description, evidence? }; routed to the town's admins.
GET /api/reports/:id/conversation: The chat between the two people a report is about, unsent messages marked (admins; logged).
GET /api/reports: The reports queue (municipal admins: own town; paginated).
PUT /api/reports/:id/status: Set status PENDING | UNDER_REVIEW | RESOLVED | DISMISSED.
POST /api/addresses: Add an address (town, barangay, street, contact, optional pin).
POST /api/vouchers/validate: Check a code against a cart; returns the discount.
GET /api/vouchers/store/:storeId: A shop's live vouchers for its page.
POST /api/vouchers: Create a platform voucher (PERCENT or FIXED).
GET /api/couriers: Active couriers sellers can ship with.
POST /api/couriers/quote: What delivery would cost, by the seller and by each courier (product page, checkout).
GET /api/couriers/my-store: The shop's courier choices and rates.
PUT /api/couriers/my-store: Save the shop's courier choices and rates.
GET /api/messages/unread-count: Number of chats with unread messages.
GET /api/messages/conversations: The caller's chats (as buyer and as seller).
POST /api/messages/conversations: Open (or reuse) a chat with a store, or a seller with a buyer.
GET /api/messages/conversations/:id: One chat with its messages (and any price offer).
DELETE /api/messages/conversations/:id/m: Unsend (delete) your own message, within 5 hours of sending it.
POST /api/messages/conversations/:id/rea: Mark the chat read (not rate limited).
POST /api/messages/conversations/:id/rat: Buyer rates the shop's chat service.
GET /api/notifications: The caller's notifications (feed buyer/seller, category, paging), each with its target and picture.
GET /api/support/inbox: Admin inbox of support cases (municipal admins: own town; paginated).
POST /api/support/cases: Open a case { category, subject, message } with the town's admin.
POST /api/support/cases/for-user/:userId: An admin opens a case with a user.
POST /api/support/chat/municipal: Legacy alias: open a chat with the municipal admin.
GET /api/support/chat/my: Legacy alias of GET cases (old shape).
POST /api/upload/image: Public image (product, shop, proof, avatar); answers { url, filename } (WebP, max 1600 px).
POST /api/upload/private-image: Upload a private photo (payment or delivery proof, chat, return or report photo); shown only through signed links.
POST /api/upload/kyc: Private KYC document; answers an opaque { fileId }.
POST /api/upload/model3d: A product's GLB or USDZ 3D model; answers { url, filename, type, bytes }.
POST /api/identity-verification: Verify your identity with a photo of a Philippine government ID (front, and back if needed). The photo is read and not stored; a few tries a day.
GET /api/analytics/seller: The seller's dashboard (KPIs, sales by day, top products, low stock, funnel) for a date window.
GET /api/analytics/municipality: A town's marketplace figures (municipal admins: own town).
GET /api/analytics/platform: Province-wide figures, sales by municipality, top stores.
GET /api/audit-logs: Audit trail (municipal admins: own municipality; filters; paginated).
POST /api/announcements: Broadcast to an audience (all users, sellers, admins; municipal admins: own town) as SYSTEM_ANNOUNCEMENT notifications.
POST /api/admin/junior-admins: Make a user a municipal admin of a town (optionally until a date).
DELETE /api/admin/junior-admins/:id: Remove a municipal admin (back to buyer).
GET /api/admin-team: The town's admin team with online status.
POST /api/admin-team: Add an admin (adder's authenticator code required; team cap).
GET /api/admin-team/chats: The team chat and pair chats with last messages.
GET /api/admin-team/chats/:thread: Messages of 'team' or of the chat with another admin's id.
DELETE /api/admin-team/:id: Remove an admin from the team.
POST /api/admin-messages: Start a thread with a municipal admin.
GET /api/admin-messages: Threads (municipal admins: only their own), paginated.
GET /api/moderation/identity/:userId: A buyer's identity verification for manual review.
POST /api/moderation/identity/:userId/re: Approve or reject an identity verification manually.
POST /api/banners: Create a banner (placement HOME_CAROUSEL | HOME_SIDEBAR_TOP | HOME_SIDEBAR_BOTTOM | HOME_POPUP).
GET /api/app-settings: Global settings: logo, placeholder, theme, delivery fees, free-delivery threshold, switches (buyer verification, Available Today, MoorMove, 3D views), category style, admin team cap.
